t: What he asked to be kept among
a: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْيِنِي مِسْكِينًا وَأَمِتْنِي مِسْكِينًا وَاحْشُرْنِي فِي زُمْرَةِ الْمَسَاكِينِ
p: Allāhumma aḥyinī miskīnan wa amitnī miskīnan wa-ḥshurnī fī zumrati-l-masākīn
m: O Allah, let me live poor, let me die poor, and gather me in the company of the poor.
